notes.title: Park Bound 1.8.0-1.8.8 Released
notes.notes:
[h1]1.8.0[/h1]
[list]
[*]Add new particle effects options in level editor
[*]Fixed bug causing treasure podiums with nine or more stars to display incorrectly
[*]Updated Steamworks SDK
[/list]
Update is required to play recently uploaded parks or with other players on 1.8.0+. Players with older versions will be split into their own sectors.


[h1]1.8.1[/h1]
[list]
[*]Moved Lantern Festival event forward to February 1 - February 20
[*]Events now start at 6 AM EST instead of 6 PM EST
[/list]


[h1]1.8.2[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added support for players to create multiple parks
[/list]

[h1]1.8.3[/h1]
[list]
[*]Enabled option to set teleport receivers to be invisible or uncollidable in level editor
[*]Fixed bug causing gyroball collision sound effect playing while jumping
[/list]

[h1]1.8.4[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added feature to reset progress made in a park. If you reset your progress after completing all chests in the park you will earn a prestige point for that park to track the number of times you completed a park. This feature is accessible through the "info" button in each park from the park overworld.
[/list]

[h1]1.8.5[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug causing camera to not move smoothly when immediately jumping after landing on higher platform
[*]Fixed bug causing some objects to be rendered when not in camera view
[*]Editor: Added ability to restore deleted zones from an uploaded park. Under the Upload tab, right click on the icon of any zone shown in the "Removed" section and press restore.
[/list]

[h1]1.8.6[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug in the level editor where meshes with too many triangles could trigger crash under some conditions.
[/list]

[h1]1.8.7[/h1]
[list]
[*]Editor - Zone entrance button in park now applies all material properties instead of just color.
[*]Editor - Zone screens collidability / visibility can now be configured.
[/list]

[h1]1.8.8[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue with 1.8.7 update causing some player parks to not load correctly.
[/list]

notes.notes:

[list]
[*]Players with Windows operating systems now use the 64-bit version of the game by default. This version has improved load times and has significantly improved performance on large levels. 
[*]Fixed bug that could cause sound effects to play incorrectly on some hardware configurations.
[*]Fixed bug causing morphing shapes with attached objects to render incorrectly in the level editor.
[/list]
Note: Mac and Linux operating systems already use the 64-bit version. The Windows 32-bit version is still available to use under the debug build of the game. If you have any issues playing the latest version please make a post on the Bugs & Technical help forum.

notes.title: Launching tomorrow, 1.4.7 & 1.4.8 released
notes.notes:
Park Bound will be leaving Early Access and launching tomorrow at 17:00 GMT (11:00 AM CST). Thanks everyone who participated in Early Access. It has been great to play with you all in-game, see your screenshots/videos, and explore the community created parks. Hope to see you there on launch! Also, update 1.4.7 is released to include various editor fixes and improvements.

[h1]Game[/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated park browser icons and overworld console.
[/list]
[h1]Editor[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug causing the select mode interface to sometimes show the incorrect mode after refresh.
[*]Fixed grid snapping not applying correctly when drag-translating if grid size was greater than one.
[*]Fixed bug causing global bounding box to be displayed incorrectly under some situations.
[*]Fixed bug causing interpolation menu to sometimes not close correctly when selecting new object.
[*]Fixed bug causing undo-redo system to work incorrectly after creating a new level.
[*]Re-ordered rotation hotkey menu controls. Removed confirm button icon until axis selected.
[*]Fixed bug causing objects created by a decompiling a prefab to be positioned incorrectly if they weren't previously attached.
[*]Decompiling a prefab will now add an undo save point.
[*]Updated color hex field to accept strings of 6 characters even if the field supports an alpha channel (8 characters).
[*]Fixed color hex field to maintain cursor position when typing.
[*]Fixed bug causing environment mixer menu to open when editing a prefab.
[/list]


[h1]1.4.8[/h1]
[h1]Editor[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug introduced in 1.4.7 that would cause an error if a prefab was decompiled within another prefab.
[/list]

[h1]1.4.1[/h1]

[h1]Editor[/h1]
[list]
[*]If the camera is inside the selected object bounding box then it is no longer clickable (making it easier to select other objects).
[*]Capsules shapes now use tight bounds instead of maximum bounds for bounding box calculation when inside a prefab.
[*]Fixed bug that could cause the bounding box to become unclickable until the level was refreshed.
[*]Fixed rotating by global axis not giving correct output under some situations.

[list]
[*]Can drag the object bounds to translate, rotate, or scale. If scale mode is selected and object is unscalable it will default to translate (prefabs for example).
[*]Display for global vs local axis. Uses exiting hotkey for toggling axis (tab by default).
[*]Enable/disable grid snap. Can still hold toggle key to temporarily enable or disable (ctrl by default).
[*]Buttons for changing grid snap size and new hotkeys (left/right bracket by default).
[*]Advanced mode will show a smaller menu without labels.
[/list]

[h1]Game[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug allowing levels to place multiple treasure chests causing the game to freeze when opened.

[/list]

[/list]

[/list]
